#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MODULUS_VALUE = 998244353;

vector<int> get_divisors_list(int n) {
    vector<int> res;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            res.push_back(i);
            if (i != n / i) res.push_back(n / i);
        }
    }
    sort(res.begin(), res.end());
    return res;
}

long long modular_pow(long long n) {
    long long result = 1, base = n, exp = MODULUS_VALUE - 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MODULUS_VALUE;
        base = (base * base) % MODULUS_VALUE;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

    auto get_max_score = [&]() {
        return min(rock1, sci2) + min(sci1, paper2) + min(paper1, rock2);
    };

    auto match_types = [](int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    };

    auto compute_min_score = [&](vector<vector<int>> l1, vector<vector<int>> l2) {
        int total = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.empty() || !l2.empty()) {
            if (c1 == 0 && !l1.empty()) {
                c1 = l1.back()[0];
                int type1 = l1.back()[1];

                int type2 = l2.back()[1];

            }
            if (c1 == 0 || c2 == 0) break;
            int match_score = max(0, min(c1, c2) * match_types(l1.back()[1], l2.back()[1]));
            total += match_score;
            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return total;
    };

    auto find_minimum = [&]() {
        vector<vector<int>> perms1, perms2;

        do {
            perms2.push_back(base2);

                vector<vector<int>> p1_copy = p1;
                vector<vector<int>> p2_copy = p2;
                min_ans = min(min_ans, compute_min_score(p1_copy, p2_copy));
            }

        return min_ans;
    };

    cout << find_minimum() << " " << get_max_score() << "\n";
